description: The pie chart, titled "Stimuli Type," displays the distribution of different types of stimuli used in case studies related to generative AI in journalism, with each segment representing a category and its corresponding frequency out of a total of 38 cases. The largest segment, colored dark green, represents "External News Article" and accounts for 15 of the 38 cases (approximately 39.5%). The second largest segment, in dark red, corresponds to "Draft/Other" and makes up 9 of the 38 cases (approximately 23.7%). The "Email" category, shown in a medium red, accounts for 5 cases (approximately 13.2%). "Press Release" is represented by a yellow segment, comprising 4 cases (approximately 10.5%). The "Interview" category, in purple, accounts for 2 cases (approximately 5.3%), and the smallest segment, in orange, represents "Intra-agency news article," making up 1 case (approximately 2.6%). The chart is labeled with the type of stimulus and its count as a fraction of the total, with the title centered within the donut chart. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, starting from the top with the "Intra-agency news article" and proceeding through the other categories.
